impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Ok(record) = [
            &mut self.first_consumer_of_the_lane_xxxxxxx,
            &mut self.second_consumer_of_the_lane_xxxxxxxx,
        ][lane]
            .try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
